title: JalSakhi 🌾💧
shortDescription: An AI-powered precision agriculture platform revolutionizing water management for Indian farmers through predictive ML models and smart allocation.
description: JalSakhi (Water Friend) is a comprehensive, AI-driven precision agriculture ecosystem designed to tackle acute water scarcity challenges faced by Indian farmers. Built as a scalable cross-platform mobile application, it bridges the gap between advanced Machine Learning technologies and grassroots farming practices. The platform aggregates local environmental data to deliver actionable insights—ranging from hyper-local 7-day soil moisture forecasts to intelligent crop water predictions. By providing dedicated interfaces for both individual farmers and regional administrators, JalSakhi facilitates not only on-the-ground irrigation efficiency but also macro-level village water allocation, ultimately driving sustainable agricultural practices at scale.
myContributions: Architected and developed a fully responsive cross-platform mobile application using React Native and Expo, ensuring a seamless user experience across varied mobile devices.
Engineered a robust Node.js and Express backend REST API, utilizing MongoDB Atlas for scalable data persistence and JWT for secure, role-based access control.
Designed and implemented a secure ML Gateway that effectively manages API Key authentication and implements rate limiting, shielding the Python ML services from unauthorized access.

Deployed a suite of four highly specialized FastAPI ML microservices to handle complex operations: Crop Water Prediction, Soil Moisture Forecasting, Village Water Allocation, and AI Chatbot interactions.
Integrated a high-performance Groq-powered Llama 3.1 LLM chatbot, meticulously tailored to provide real-time, context-aware agricultural advice in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
Established a secure local development workflow utilizing Ngrok tunneling to facilitate real-time mobile testing against local AI microservices.

features: Smart Crop Management: Empowers farmers to seamlessly track multiple farms, crop life cycles, and historical irrigation logs.
AI-Driven Water Predictions: Leverages RandomForest models to provide highly accurate, data-driven irrigation recommendations, preventing over-watering.
7-Day Soil Moisture Forecast: Utilizes advanced time-series forecasting (Prophet/LSTM) to predict soil conditions up to a week in advance, allowing for proactive planning.
Multilingual AI Chatbot: An integrated, Groq-powered Llama 3.1 assistant delivering instant, culturally relevant agricultural guidance in Hindi, Marathi, and English.
Intelligent Water Allocation: Features heuristic AI-optimized distribution logic for administrators to equitably manage water resources across entire communities.
Village Analytics Dashboard: Provides administrators with real-time insights, systemic anomaly detection, and reservoir monitoring to ensure regional sustainability.
challenges: Architectural Complexity: Seamlessly integrating four distinct, computationally heavy Machine Learning models via Python FastAPI into a unified, responsive React Native mobile experience.
Data Security & API Integrity: Implementing a robust ML Gateway to securely route traffic between the Node.js backend and Python microservices while preventing abuse through rate limiting.
Predictive Accuracy: Ensuring the 7-day soil moisture forecasts and crop water predictions remained accurate despite utilizing disparate environmental data sources and varying regional inputs.

Multilingual LLM Performance: Tuning prompts and context windows for the Groq Llama 3.1 model to consistently return accurate agricultural advice in multiple regional Indian languages without hallucination.
learnings: Mastered the design and orchestration of a multi-tier microservice architecture, effectively bridging a React Native frontend with specialized Python FastAPI AI services via a secure Node.js Gateway.
Deepened expertise in applying time-series forecasting (LSTM/Prophet) and classification models (RandomForest) to solve real-world agricultural problems.
Gained significant experience in building highly accessible, multilingual user interfaces tailored specifically for diverse and often non-technical userbases in rural India.
Learned advanced LLM integration techniques, specifically optimizing prompt engineering for domain-specific tasks using the Groq API.
metrics: Architected to scale and target a potential user base of 50M+ Indian Farmers.
Successfully deployed and orchestrated 4 distinct Machine Learning models operating concurrently in production.
Achieved comprehensive multilingual support covering 3 major languages (English, Hindi, Marathi) for maximum regional accessibility.

clientTestimonial.name: Sameer Bagul
clientTestimonial.quote: Building JalSakhi was driven by a deep passion to solve critical real-world water scarcity problems. By merging scalable AI microservices with accessible, multilingual mobile interfaces, we created a tool that genuinely empowers Indian farmers.

futureRoadmap: Expand external weather API integrations to provide hyper-local, real-time meteorological forecasting.
Transition from purely predictive modeling to integrating physical IoT sensors for real-time field data ingestion.
Expand native language support to include more regional Indian dialects to widen the platform's accessibility footprint.
Implement a community-driven forum feature allowing farmers to share insights and best practices directly within the app.
